hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buy-and-burn/buyback mechanism: on buys, 1% of ETH input is collected into a burn pot; on sells, 1% of tokens are queued for burning. Every 20 swaps, a buyback-and-burn can be triggered. Sell swaps revert in the same block as a buyback and can be gated by an owner-controlled allowlist checked via tx.origin.
